argv:
p='configparser.py';s=open(p).read()
old=r'''            (?:\s+(?:(?!{delim})\S)+)*)    # optionally more words'''
new=r'''            (?:(?:(?!{delim})\s)+           # optionally more words, joined
               (?:(?!{delim})\S)+)*)       # by non-delimiter whitespace'''
assert s.count(old)==2, s.count(old)
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
